svg.title: Hey, I'm Kanav. I'm studying Computer Science at IIIT Bangalore, graduating in 2028. I like asking questions and sticking with something until it finally makes sense. Lately, I've been getting deeper into AI/ML, systems, and backend engineering. I enjoy figuring out how things work under the hood, even when it means learning from my own bugs. Outside coding, I'm into cricket, the gym, travelling, and collecting way too many jerseys. I also keep telling myself I'll watch “just one more episode.” Ctrl + Z is a lifestyle.
